 hCaptcha: protect privacy while stopping spam and abuse 
 Do you use a captcha to keep out bots? hCaptcha is a drop-in replacement for reCAPTCHA that puts user privacy first.

 Back to top 

 About hCaptcha 
 hCaptcha is a privacy-first CAPTCHA service that provides protection against automated abuse. 

 hCaptcha Enterprise extends this platform to include the bot management features high traffic enterprises need: risk scores, "No-CAPTCHA" and 99.9% passive modes, and more.

 This project supports all versions of the service.

 Requirements 
 
 hCaptcha depends on the CAPTCHA module. 
 PHP 5.5 or higher.
